use default
use System.Math

use DIVISION = (quotient: List[double], remainder: List[double])

degree(poly: List[double]) -> int =>
    let highest =
        (0::poly.count - 1)
            |> reverse()
            |> find(power => poly[power] != 0.0D) in
    highest ?? -1

divide(numerator: List[double], denominator: List[double]) -> DIVISION is
    let divisor_degree = degree(denominator)
    let remainder = numerator |> collect_list()
    let quotient = LIST[double]()

    for _ in 0::degree(numerator) - divisor_degree do
        quotient.add(0.0D)
    od

    while degree(remainder) >= divisor_degree /\ degree(remainder) >= 0 do
        let shift = degree(remainder) - divisor_degree
        let factor =
            remainder[degree(remainder)] / denominator[divisor_degree]

        quotient[shift] = factor

        for power in 0::divisor_degree do
            remainder[shift + power] =
                remainder[shift + power] - factor * denominator[power]
        od
    od

    (quotient = quotient, remainder = remainder)
si

term(size: double, power: int) -> string =>
    let head = if size == 1.0D /\ power > 0 then "" else "{size:G}" fi in
    case power
    when 0 then head
    when 1 then "{head}x"
    else "{head}x^{power}"
    esac

render(poly: List[double]) -> string is
    let top = degree(poly)

    if top < 0 then return "0" fi

    let parts = LIST[string]()

    for power in (0::top) |> reverse() do
        let size = Math.abs(poly[power])

        if poly[power] != 0.0D then
            let sign =
                if poly[power] < 0.0D then
                    if parts.count == 0 then "-" else "- " fi
                else
                    if parts.count == 0 then "" else "+ " fi
                fi

            parts.add("{sign}{term(size, power)}")
        fi
    od

    parts |> join(" ")
si

show(numerator: List[double], denominator: List[double]) is
    let split = divide(numerator, denominator)

    write_line("  ({render(numerator)}) / ({render(denominator)})")
    write_line("    quotient:  {render(split.quotient)}")
    write_line("    remainder: {render(split.remainder)}")
si

write_line("polynomial long division:")

show([-42.0D, 0.0D, -12.0D, 1.0D], [-3.0D, 1.0D])
show([-1.0D, 0.0D, 0.0D, 0.0D, 1.0D], [-1.0D, 0.0D, 1.0D])
show([2.0D, 3.0D], [1.0D, 0.0D, 1.0D])
